AUTHOR: Böer
TITLE: A Deep-Learning Based Pipeline for Estimating the Abundance and Size of Aquatic Organisms in an Unconstrained Underwater Environment from Continuously Captured Stereo Video
REGION: Kiel Fjord, western Baltic Sea, Germany
SPECIES: Gadus morhua, Clupeidae, Salmonidae, Scomber scombrus, Pleuronectoidei, fish unspecified + 4 jellyfish/ctenophore classes
DATA: Own UFO (Underwater Fish Observatory) stereo low-light video; 73,144 annotated images, 92,899 boxes, 1198 tracks
V_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'recordings were made under varying light conditions, ranging from sunrise to sunset, and in a diverse range of visibility conditions, from relatively clear... to heavily turbid water'
D2: 85/15 train/val random per image (60,144/13,000); 18.5% of val images from days absent from training
D_EV: Sec. 4: 'the random sampling employed can place very similar images in the data-splits, which may lead to an underestimation of the error.'
R_EV: Sec. 4: results only on the validation split of the same UFO dataset: 'The results obtained on the validation data were evaluated using common metrics'
C_EV: Sec. 4: 'the maximum mean F1 score of 93% was achieved at a confidence level of 0.625' (F1/PR curves, Fig. 9)
E_EV: Sec. 4: only detection metrics reported: 'The model achieved a mean detection accuracy of 92.4%, a mean average precision (mAP) of 94.8% and an F1 score of 93%'
ARCH: YOLOv5l6 + background-subtraction activity filter + bounding-box stereo matching for size/distance; MaxN abundance
METR: mAP@0.5, F1, per-class accuracy, confusion matrix (with background row)
NOTE: MaxN abundance and stereo size estimation are described but no fish abundance/size results are reported or validated; stereo validated only on a checkerboard target and sonar distance of a diver-held target. ENV coded 하구/기수 as Kiel Fjord is a brackish Baltic inlet (could be argued temperate marine). Depth 22 m mentioned only for camera low-light verification in North Sea, not the study site, so V2 = NR. V4 = Y from calibration range 0.5-2.0 m and measurement error vs distance (Fig. 6). Pretrained YOLOv5l6 weights source not named (likely COCO). Validation set partially from unseen days but headline split is random per image. Confusion-matrix background row gives per-class misses (E4 = FNR).
